questions.question: Which manager led Middlesbrough to victory in the 2004 League Cup final and guided them to the UEFA Cup final in 2006 before taking charge of the England national team?
questions.explanation: Steve McClaren enjoyed a historic spell at the Riverside Stadium, lifting Middlesbrough's first major trophy in 2004 and reaching the 2006 UEFA Cup final against Sevilla.
questions.anchorClues: Steve McClaren / Middlesbrough 2004 League Cup and UEFA Cup

questions.question: True or False: Arsenal's 2001–02 title-winning side holds the Premier League record for scoring in every single match of a 38-game league campaign.
questions.explanation: Arsène Wenger's Arsenal scored in all 38 Premier League fixtures during the 2001–02 season on their way to winning the double, a record that remains unique in Premier League history.
questions.anchorClues: Arsenal 2001–02 / Scoring in every Premier League match

questions.question: What was the final scoreline when Tottenham Hotspur famously defeated Wigan Athletic at White Hart Lane in November 2009, with Jermain Defoe scoring five second-half goals?
questions.explanation: Harry Redknapp's Spurs tore apart Wigan Athletic 9–1, with Jermain Defoe netting five goals in a historic second-half display.

questions.question: Which Scottish manager guided West Midlands side West Bromwich Albion to a famous 'Great Escape' on the final day of the 2004–05 season, becoming the first Premier League side to survive relegation after being bottom on Christmas Day?
questions.explanation: Former Manchester United captain Bryan Robson oversaw West Bromwich Albion's dramatic survival on Sunday 15 May 2005, following a 2–0 victory over Portsmouth at The Hawthorns.
questions.anchorClues: Bryan Robson / West Brom Great Escape 2004–05

questions.question: True or False: Chelsea's John Terry is the highest-scoring defender in Premier League history, netting 41 goals in the competition.
questions.explanation: John Terry scored 41 Premier League goals across 19 seasons at Stamford Bridge, placing him top of the all-time defender scoring list ahead of David Unsworth (38) and Ian Harte (28).
questions.anchorClues: John Terry all-time highest scoring defender Premier League

questions.question: Which Argentine striker shared the 2010–11 Premier League Golden Boot with Dimitar Berbatov after scoring 20 goals for Manchester City?
questions.explanation: Carlos Tevez scored 20 league goals in 2010–11 to captain Manchester City to 3rd place and share the Golden Boot award with former teammate Berbatov.
questions.anchorClues: Carlos Tevez / Premier League Golden Boot 2010–11 Manchester City

questions.question: Which iconic squad number was handed to Cristiano Ronaldo upon his arrival at Manchester United in August 2003, following the departure of David Beckham to Real Madrid?
questions.explanation: Alex Ferguson insisted that 18-year-old Cristiano Ronaldo take the club's famed number 7 shirt—previously worn by Best, Robson, Cantona, and Beckham—rather than his requested number 28.
questions.anchorClues: Cristiano Ronaldo squad number 7 / Manchester United 2003

questions.question: Which Spanish midfielder spent five seasons at Liverpool before joining Real Madrid in 2009, famous for scoring a 70-yard goal against Luton Town in the FA Cup and another from inside his own half against Newcastle United in the Premier League?
questions.explanation: Xabi Alonso pulled off his iconic long-range strike against Newcastle United from inside his own half at Anfield in September 2006.
questions.anchorClues: Xabi Alonso / Liverpool long-range goals Newcastle

questions.question: Which club recorded the fewest goals scored in a single 38-game Premier League season, finding the net just 28 times during the 2006–07 campaign under Stuart Pearce?
questions.explanation: Prior to modern takeovers, Manchester City scored only 28 league goals in 2006–07—including a dismal 10 goals at home all season.
questions.anchorClues: Manchester City 2006–07 / Fewest goals scored season

questions.question: Which Nigerian striker scored Premier League hat-tricks for three different clubs, accomplishing the feat for Portsmouth, Everton, and Blackburn Rovers?
questions.explanation: Yakubu Ayegbeni proved a prolific goalscorer across the top flight, netting PL hat-tricks for Portsmouth (2004), Everton (2007), and Blackburn Rovers (2011).
questions.anchorClues: Yakubu / Premier League hat-tricks three different clubs
